script.text: What if a cyclone closes Chennai port for 5 days?

Under a 5-day closure, **Hyderabad-Shamshabad** runs out of vaccines in **3.2 days (TTS)** at the median, but Chennai port needs **~5 days to recover (TTR)**. Stock-out probability is **100%** without action.

I recommend **Plan A — reroute via Vizag + transfer 1,200 units from Bengaluru**. It lifts service to 97.8% for ₹18.4 L, a third of the air-expedite cost. Evidence: event log rows 1,204–1,391, Monte Carlo seed 1000–1499.
